base = "unpacked_qr_report"

W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"

def local(tag):
    return tag.split("}")[1] if "}" in tag else tag

# --- styles.xml: collect paragraph styles and their names ---
styles_dom = minidom.parse(styles_xml)
style_info = {}  # styleId -> (name, has_outline_lvl)
for st in styles_dom.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "style"):
    if st.getAttributeNS(W, "type") not in ("paragraph", ""):
        continue
    sid = st.getAttributeNS(W, "styleId")
    name = ""
    for n in st.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "name"):
        name = n.getAttributeNS(W, "val")
        break
    has_outline = len(st.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "outlineLvl")) > 0
    style_info[sid] = (name, has_outline)

# --- document.xml: enumerate paragraphs ---
dom = minidom.parse(doc_xml)
paras = dom.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "p")
print("total paragraphs:", len(paras))

def para_text(p):
    out = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "t"):
        out.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
    for d in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "delText"):
        out.append("[DEL:" + (d.firstChild.nodeValue if d.firstChild else "") + "]")
    return "".join(out)

style_counts = {}
for p in paras:
    sid = None
    for ps in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "pStyle"):
        sid = ps.getAttributeNS(W, "val")
        break
    style_counts[sid] = style_counts.get(sid, 0) + 1

print("\nstyle usage (pStyle val -> count):")
for sid, cnt in sorted(style_counts.items(), key=lambda x: (x[0] is None, x[0] or "")):
    info = style_info.get(sid, ("<not-in-styles>", False))
    print(f"  {sid!r:20} count={cnt:4}  styleName={info[0]!r} outlineLvl={info[1]}")

# candidate headline styles
def is_headline_style(sid):
    if sid is None:
        return False
    info = style_info.get(sid)
    if not info:
        return False
    name, has_outline = info
    nm = (name or "").lower()
    return has_outline or "heading" in nm or sid.lower().startswith("heading") or "title" in nm

print("\ncandidate headline styles:", {s: style_info[s] for s in style_info if is_headline_style(s)})

        break
    if is_headline_style(sid):
        txt = para_text(p)
        print(f"  p#{i} style={sid!r} text={txt!r}")

import io
import re

DOC_PATH = "unpacked/word/document.xml"

EXPECTED_HEADLINES = {
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
}

# Headline heuristic for this report: standalone run text that is non-empty,
# contains no lowercase letters, contains at least one uppercase letter, and
# has no entity/symbol content (excludes bullets, the ---- rule, table rows,
# and body paragraphs which all contain lowercase text).
def is_headline(text):
    stripped = text.strip()
    if not stripped:
        return False
    if "&#" in stripped:  # entity-encoded symbols (bullets, box-drawing line)
        return False
    return any(c.isupper() for c in stripped) and not any(
        c.islower() for c in stripped
    )


with io.open(DOC_PATH, "r", encoding="ascii") as f:
    xml = f.read()

run_re = re.compile(
    r"<w:r>\s*<w:rPr>(.*?)</w:rPr>\s*<w:t xml:space=\"preserve\">(.*?)</w:t>",
    re.S,
)

underlined = []
count = 0


def repl(m):
    global count
    rpr = m.group(1)
    text = m.group(2)
    if is_headline(text) and "<w:u " not in rpr:
        rpr = rpr.replace(
            "</w:sz-cs>", "</w:sz-cs>\n          <w:u w:val=\"single\"/>", 1
        )
        underlined.append(text.strip())
        count += 1
    full = m.group(0)
    start, end = m.start(1) - m.start(0), m.end(1) - m.start(0)
    return full[:start] + rpr + full[end:]


new_xml, n_subs = run_re.subn(repl, xml)

assert n_subs == len(EXPECTED_HEADLINES), (
    "Run match count mismatch: %d runs matched, expected %d"
    % (n_subs, len(EXPECTED_HEADLINES))
)
assert count == len(EXPECTED_HEADLINES), (
    "Underlined %d headlines, expected %d" % (count, len(EXPECTED_HEADLINES))
)
assert set(underlined) == EXPECTED_HEADLINES, (
    "Unexpected headline set: %r" % (set(underlined),)
)

with io.open(DOC_PATH, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
    f.write(new_xml)

print("Underlined %d headlines:" % count)
for h in sorted(underlined):
    print("  - " + h)
